lines.text: Morning, {name}! The chickens and I have been waiting. Mostly the chickens.
Oh look who decided to show up. Kidding! Kind of. Hi!
You're back! I kept everything alive. Mostly.
Guess what? Nothing exploded while you were gone. Big win.
Took you long enough. The farm missed you. I did not. Okay, a little.
Hey {name}. Coffee first, or crops first? I won't judge. Much.
Welcome back to {farm}! Smells like dirt and possibility.
I counted the eggs while you were gone. Then I lost count. Then I gave up.
I swept the porch. Luna sat on it immediately. Typical.
Hi hi hi! Okay, I'm calm. I'm totally calm. Let's farm!
Ah, the boss returns. Your crops have been very patient. Unlike me.
There she is! The cows did a little shuffle when they heard your car.
Good to see you. The farm feels more like a farm when you're here.
Don't look in the barn. Just kidding, everything's fine. Probably.
Hi {name}! I named a worm Gerald. He's thriving.
You know what this farm needs? You. Clicking things. Let's go.
Back already? Love the enthusiasm. Let's make some coins.
I fed the chickens. Well, I watched the chickens feed themselves. Teamwork.
Hey there, farmer! Claire called. She always calls.
Welcome home. Take your time, nothing here is in a hurry.
I would have done the harvesting myself, but I'm eleven. Labor laws.
Hi! The sun is out, or it isn't, but either way, hi!
Not that I was waiting by the window or anything. Hi.
You're here! Quick, before Luna takes your spot on the porch.
I learned three new knots today. None of them are useful. Hello!
Morning, {name}. The blackberries are plotting again. We'll stop them.
Another day, another bramble. Ready to show it who's boss?
Hey. Whatever kind of day it's been, the farm's happy you're here.
Look who it is! The greatest farmer in {town}. Maybe in the whole county.
I had a snack from the pantry. It was research.
Welcome back! I have so many tips. Brace yourself.
Hi. The rooster yelled at me. I yelled back. We're even.
Hey {name}! I think the farm got prettier overnight. Or my eyes are tired.
I fixed a fence board. It's crooked, but it's MY crooked.
Hi there. Want to see what's ready? I peeked already.
The hens and I have formed a committee. You are our favorite.
You came back! Luna pretends she didn't notice, but she noticed.
Hi! Did you know cows have best friends? I asked them. They wouldn't tell me.
Fun fact: if you stand still in the pasture long enough, a cow will lick you. Ask me how I know.
Another lovely day at {farm}. Let's make it a good one.
Tap a growing crop to tend it. It shaves off a little time. Every little bit counts!
Pro tip: tap and drag across ready plots to harvest them all in one sweep. You're welcome.
Nothing spoils on this farm. Stockpile now, sell when the price is right.
Short crops are great while you're here. Long crops are great overnight. Pick based on when you'll be back.
Claire's orders pay better than the farm stand. Check her board often.
Mini games skip timers. Three stars cuts the wait in half! Skill beats waiting.
The Farmers Market is only open Saturday and Sunday. Plan ahead, farmer.
If a crop is out of season when the week flips, it turns into compost and you get half the seed money back. No harm done.
The honor box earns coins even while you sleep. Upgrade it for more.
Watch for the golden butterfly. Tap it before it flies off. Trust me.
Brush your cows. Happy cows make more milk. Science! Probably.
The Almanac on the kitchen table gets clearer hints when you upgrade it.
Upgrading the farmhouse makes everything sell for more. Reputation matters, even out here.
You can't lose anything on this farm. Seriously. Relax and have fun.
Daily wishes are three tiny jobs. They give ribbons. Ribbons buy cute stuff.
The Season Journal resets every Monday. Every harvest, craft, and sale fills it up.
Wine gets better if you leave it in the barrel longer. Young, then Cellared, then Reserve.
Claire's chalkboard hints at next week's market. She only talks about food, though.
Selling too much of one thing at the market drops the price. Mix it up!
The greenhouse can grow one thing out of season. Upgrade it for more beds.
You can name your cows and chickens. I suggested Sir Moo-a-lot. I was overruled.
Tourists sometimes wander by the road. They pay extra for random stuff. Tourists are weird.
Collect All grabs everything that's ready in one tap. Very efficient. Very you.
Hats! Cows can wear hats. Check the Style tab. This is the most important tip I have.
Restoring parcels unlocks more plots. More plots, more crops, more coins. Math!
The weekly basket streak never resets if you miss a day. It just waits for you.
Decorate in the Style tab. Tap and hold a decoration on the farm to move it.
Weed Pull at the greenhouse speeds up every crop growing on the farm. Sneaky good.
Egg Catch at the coop speeds up the hens. Milk Rhythm at the barn speeds up the cows.
Mini games have a 20 minute reward cooldown, but you can always play for high scores.
Lucky ladybugs are tiny. Look closely. I have excellent eyes. You'll manage.
Your save is precious. Copy a save code in Settings once in a while, just in case.
The kitchen queue keeps cooking while you're away. Load it up before bed!
Hot items at the market can sell for more than double. That's where the money is.
Every Monday is a new season here. Fall, Winter, Spring, Summer, then around again.
Codex collections give bonus ribbons when you finish a set.
Andrew's weekly specials change every Monday. Don't sleep on the candy corn bowl.
There's no wrong way to play. Little check-ins are perfect.
Wine pairs with Claire's fancy orders once her cafe is level 3. She's very excited about it.
Luna is completely useless. That's her whole thing. Pet her anyway.
Not that I was eavesdropping, but... {hint}
Okay so I overheard some folks at the feed store. {hint}
Hot gossip! {hint}
A little bird told me. Actually it was a big crow. {hint}
Word around {town} is... {hint}
You didn't hear this from me. {hint}
My friend's mom's cousin said... {hint}
Market scoop, fresh off the porch: {hint}
If I were you, I'd think about this for next weekend. {hint}
I was definitely not hiding behind the cafe counter when I heard this. {hint}
Ugh, fine, I'll share my secret intel. {hint}
The grown-ups at the post office keep saying... {hint}
I have sources. Very reliable sources. Mostly. {hint}
Okay okay okay. Listen. {hint}
Just a hunch, but... {hint}
Everybody in town is gossiping again. {hint}
The mail carrier told the librarian, who told me. {hint}
Planning tip for next week! {hint}
I read it in a newspaper. Okay, it was a flyer. Okay, I made a paper airplane out of it first. {hint}
Don't say I never help you. {hint}
Big news for market day! {hint}
Psst. {hint}
Something to plant toward, maybe? {hint}
I heard it at Andrew's. He was talking to a lady with a very large hat. {hint}
Between you, me, and Luna: {hint}
Weekend forecast: {hint}
I'm basically a market genius. {hint}
Could be nothing. Could be everything. {hint}
You owe me a cookie for this one. {hint}
For what it's worth: {hint}
The cows told me. Kidding. {hint}
Town chatter says... {hint}
I'm only telling you because you're my favorite. {hint}
Listen carefully, I'll only say it twice. {hint} ...that was once. Okay, I'm done.
Scoop alert! {hint}
Might be worth stockpiling for. {hint}
Overheard at the gas station: {hint}
Claire's regulars were all saying... {hint}
Don't make that face, my tips are great. {hint}
My spy network is small but mighty. {hint}
New week, new season! It's {season} now. Here, I found you a little something.
Happy {season}! The farm looks totally different. Well, kind of. Here's a gift!
Ding ding, new season! {season} is here. I wrapped this myself. Don't look at the tape.
It's officially {season}! I decorated a little. You're welcome.
A fresh week. {season} on the farm. Take it slow and enjoy it.
{season}! {season}! I love {season}. I say that every week, but I mean it.
Welcome to {season}, {name}! The Season Journal has new rewards, too.
Out with the old, in with the {season}. That's how the saying goes, right?
I may have peeked at the new journal rewards. They're good. I'm not saying more.
New season, new crops! Check the seed list for {season} goodies.
I made the {season} banner myself. It's mostly glitter.
Monday again. A new season, and a little gift to start it off.
It's {season}! Luna has already found a new place to nap.
Another week, another season. This farm moves fast. Kind of like me.
{season} is here! Andrew's weekly specials changed too.
Rumor has it {season} is the best season. I start that rumor every week.
Look at the farm! All {season}-y. Here's your welcome gift.
Season change complete. I personally supervised it.
Hello, {season}. The cows don't care, but I do.
Fresh season! Fresh week! Fresh gift! Fresh... okay, I ran out.
{season} called, it said it's here. I said thanks. Anyway, gift!
Brand new {season}. Brand new chances to get rich. Cozy rich.
I put the old season decorations away. Kidding, you keep everything forever.
New week. Whatever last week was like, this one's fresh.
The Season Journal reset! Time to fill it up again.
It's {season}! Even the chickens look excited. Hard to tell with chickens.
Hey, wake up, it's {season}! Okay you were awake. Still. Gift!
I hid your gift. Just kidding, it's right here.
{season} vibes only. Here, this is for you.
I've been counting down to {season} all week. Well, since this morning.
Monday magic. {season} has arrived on the farm.
Did you see? It's {season}! The whole farm changed outfits.
New season, same amazing helper. That's me.
Happy new week, {name}! {season} looks good on this place.
I asked the calendar nicely and it gave us {season}. Here's a gift.
Week turned over without a hitch. {season} is officially open.
A little {season} present, from me to you.
Woo! {season}! Let's plant something great.
New season! Remember, crops that were ready stay ready. Nothing lost.
It's {season}. I'd give you a speech, but here's a gift instead. Speeches are boring.
You know, I could run this farm. I'd need a taller chair, though.
My favorite cow is all of them. Don't tell them.
Luna stole my sandwich. I have no proof. I have every proof.
I can whistle with two fingers now. It scares the chickens. Worth it.
It's really nice what you're doing here. Bringing the place back.
Claire says I talk too much. I say she listens too little. We're working on it.
Did you know Highland cows have two coats of hair? Double fluff!
Andrew has a secret candy drawer. I know where it is. I will tell you for one (1) coin.
One day I'm going to win the County Fair. For what? Doesn't matter.
I'm not saying I'm the best helper. But who else is here? Exactly.
Sometimes I just sit by the creek and listen. It's nice. Don't tell anyone.
The rooster's name is technically Mr. Business. I named him. He doesn't know.
I bet I could ride a cow. I won't. But I could.
I read the Almanac. Okay, I looked at the pictures. Great pictures.
If you need me, I'll be right here. Being incredibly helpful.
Blackberries are the worst and the best. They stab you, then they make wine.
What if we built a treehouse in Selleck Woods? Not a hint. Okay, a hint.
I like it here. It feels like home.
Luna has a secret. I don't know what it is. That's how secrets work.
You tap stuff, I give advice. It's a perfect system.
Claire's cinnamon rolls are the size of my head. I've measured.
I can tell a Highland cow from a regular cow from a mile away. It's the bangs.
Fun fact: chickens are dinosaurs. Don't tell them, they'll get ideas.
Tap me again. I dare you. Okay, that's enough. Okay, one more.
I love the smell of the farm after rain. Which is most of the time here.
What's your favorite crop? Mine's pumpkins. They're basically giant oranges you can't eat.
Thanks for letting me help. It's the best job ever.
The tourists keep asking where the bathroom is. I keep pointing at the barn.
My hat is royal blue. It's not just a hat. It's a statement.
I gave each of the chickens a secret handshake. They forgot it.
I've been practicing my auctioneer voice. SOLD! To the lady with the farm!
Andrew says he's not grumpy. He says it grumpily.
Do cows dream? What would they dream about? Grass, probably. Big grass.
It's okay to take a break. The farm will be right here.
I'd say I'm sorry for being sassy, but I'd be lying, and lying is bad.
Luna sat on the Almanac again. She's absorbing the knowledge.
There's a frog in the creek who looks exactly like Andrew. I'm just saying.
Ask me anything about farming. I know at least four things.
You're doing great. I'd tell you if you weren't. I'm very honest.
Someday this farm is going to be the prettiest one in Washington. Wait, it already is.
This is the farm! Tap plots, animals, and buildings. Pinch to zoom, drag to look around.
Tap and hold a decoration to move it. Tap and drag over ready crops to sweep them up.
See that Collect All button? It's my favorite button. After the hat button.
Pick a recipe and it goes in the queue. It keeps cooking even when you leave.
Upgrade the kitchen for more queue slots and faster cooking. And fancier recipes!
Start a batch, wait for it to ferment, then bottle it. Waiting longer makes it fancier.
Young wine sells fine. Reserve wine sells for way more. Patience, farmer.
Claire's orders refresh through the day. Fill them fast for a bonus ribbon!
Claire is a little bossy. She'd say "decisive." She's bossy.
Andrew sells lumber, nails, glass, and all the boring important stuff.
Check his "this week only" shelf. It changes every Monday.
The Farmers Market! Open Saturday and Sunday. Hot items sell for way more.
Your stall only has so many slots per day, so pick your best stuff.
Not market day? The farm stand buys anything, any day, just for a bit less.
Dress up the cows! Decorate the farm! This is the important stuff.
Hats for cows. Hats for chickens. Hats for you. Hats for everyone.
The Season Journal fills up as you play. Every tier has a reward. Resets Monday!
Quests tell the story of fixing up the farm. Some of them are mine. They're the best ones.
The codex tracks everything you've grown, bottled, and found. Finish a set for ribbons.
Copy a save code every so often and keep it somewhere safe. Just in case.
The County Fair! Starting a new Heirloom Year keeps your land, cosmetics, and collections. You trade coins for Heirloom Seeds.
No rush at all. "Not yet" is always an option.
A few crops were out of season when the week turned. I composted them and got you half the seed money back.
Those crops didn't make it to the new season. They're compost now. Very fancy compost. Half your seed money's back.
Season change turned some crops into compost. The soil says thank you. Here's half the seed cost back.
While you were away, the farm kept busy. Luna supervised.
Here's what happened while you were gone!
You left. Things happened. Here's the list.
There's an update! I read the whole thing. Here's what's new on the farm.
New stuff! I personally checked it all. Mostly.
Hi! I'm Luke. I'm eleven, I'm helpful, and I'm here to show you around. Want the tour?
Skipping the tour? Bold. Tap the "?" up top if you ever need me.
That's the basics! You're a natural. I'll be up top under the "?" if you need me.
Whoa. The County Fair is in town! You could start a new Heirloom Year whenever you want. No pressure.
Year {year} on the farm! Your land is still restored, your cows still have their hats, and you've got Heirloom Seeds to spend.
Luna is the most useless member of this farm. She's also the most important.
Luna's usefulness stat is zero. I checked. Twice.
Luna picked a new napping spot today. Can you find her?
Old cats need lots of naps. Luna is VERY good at naps.
The reward is on cooldown, but you can still play for a high score!
Perfect! That's exactly what I needed. You're a lifesaver.
Oh, these are lovely. The lunch crowd is going to fight over them.
Finally! I mean, thank you, dear. Right on time.
Beautiful, as always. Here, take a little extra.
Ooh, these would pair beautifully with a glass of something purple.
Chalkboard special idea for next week: {hint}
My regulars keep hinting. {hint} Write that down, dear.
For next weekend's market? {hint}
Store's open. Don't touch the candy drawer.
Lumber's fresh. Nails are pointy. That's all I got.
Back again? Good. Business is business.
The Almanac says: {hint}
